title: ICDE 2027 Call for Research Papers
institution: 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)
about: IEEE ICDE 2027, the 43rd International Conference on Data Engineering, takes place 17-21 May 2027 in Copenhagen, Denmark. Second-round research paper submissions are due 11 November 2026 (5 p.m. Pacific Time) via Microsoft CMT.
requirements: Second-round research paper deadline November 11, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time
Up to 5 research-track papers per author per round
Papers rejected in round 1 are not eligible for round 2 (except desk rejections for conflict-of-interest or formatting/length problems)
